purpose: External life context: geography, climate, housing, work, and stress. All AI specialists read this before searching for rare pathology; environment and routine explain findings more often and at lower cost.
_needs_input: location.city / country — enter your city and country

location.latitude and location.longitude — enter the coordinates for your city. Latitude is intentionally blank: daylight length, seasonal vitamin D synthesis, and seasonal affective patterns depend on it. Get the values from any map by city name
healthcare_access.insurance — active insurance and whether private health insurance is available
climate.type and climate.derived_facts — climate type and its consequences
air_and_water — local air and water quality
housing — housing type, heating, winter humidity, pets, and dampness
work — field, posture, screen hours, workload, and commute
circadian_context — chronotype, time zone, morning light, and shift work
stress_context.chronology_anchors — year, age, and event: moves, job changes, losses, and operations. These link symptom onset to life events
